pathAssistantSteps.info:
Converted: set by standard Lead conversion only; never manually.

Continue work on the resulting Account, Contact and Opportunity. Qualified leads should be converted after the meeting is attended.

New: imported or created; zero touches. First call is due within 1 business day.

  • Confirm owner and contact details, keep Call Attempts at 0 until outreach starts, and plan the first call.
  • Blank spreadsheet status maps to New. After the first call, record the disposition, attempts and next follow-up, then select the appropriate status.
  • Duplicate lead: run duplicate rules and merge into the master record; do not import as a live status.

Alive, but not now. Marketing re-engagement pool: long-term nurture, too small today, timing objections, 4+ no-answers. Always set Nurture Cadence + Next Follow Up.

  • Long lead Nurture: disposition = Long-Term Nurture; cadence per note (default 1 Month); note to Description.
  • Not interested: timing/budget → Not Interested disposition, 2–3 Months; reason to Description. Hard no → Unqualified.
  • Too small today: consider 3 Months unless clearly hobby-scale. Review individually before load; do not bulk-map.
  • Referral partner: prefer Account (Referral Partner record type) or Contact. If kept as Lead: Nurturing + Lead Type = Referral Partner; exclude from sales funnel metrics.
  • Selling Amazon account: normally Unqualified / Exiting Amazon; individually consider 1 Month if account-health help could support a sale.

Qualified: Amazon seller with revenue greater than $1M and a meeting booked or attended. Next step: convert.

  • Confirm Amazon seller evidence and revenue above $1M; document qualification and meeting details in Description.
  • Meeting booked: set Call Disposition = Meeting Booked and Meeting Booked = true.
  • Convert to an Opportunity after the meeting is attended. Use the standard Convert action; never manually set Converted.

Dead/permanently ineligible. Always set Disqualification Reason; details to Description.

  • Number not going through: disposition + reason = Bad Number; Bad Number = true. Bad Number / Not Qualified flags feed Friday replacement CSV (SR-4); set applicable flag.
  • No longer selling: No Longer Selling; permanently exclude from all campaigns.
  • Lead not qualified: Not Qualified = true; reason = Below Revenue Threshold / Not Amazon Seller / Other; original reason to Description.
  • Hard no: disposition + reason = Not Interested. Timing/budget → Nurturing, 2–3 Months.
  • Too small: Below Revenue Threshold if hard; otherwise consider Nurturing, 3 Months. Review individually; do not bulk-map.
  • Selling Amazon account: Exiting Amazon; optionally Nurturing, 1 Month if account-health help could support sale.

Working: active calling, attempts 1–4, busy, dropped or hot. Keep here no more than approximately 2 weeks. Record disposition, attempts and Next Follow Up.

  • Called no answer: No Answer; attempt 1; follow up +2 days. Second no answer: attempt 2; +3 days. Called 3 times: attempt 3; +1 week. Review for Nurturing after the fourth unanswered call.
  • Hot Lead!!: Interested — Hot; Rating = Hot; follow up the same or next day and create a priority task.
  • Follow up was busy: Busy — Call Back; follow up +1–2 days.
  • Dropped call: Dropped Call; follow up the same or next day.
  • Preserve notes in Description. Timing/budget objections go to Nurturing; a hard no goes to Unqualified.
